marks.selector: circle, circle.dot, circle[class*='dot'], circle[class*='bee'], circle[class*='point'], circle[class*='node'], circle[class*='obs']
marks.note: 300 total observations; min=150 allows initial filter state with some categories hidden; max=350 allows small overlap-resolution artefacts.

category_labels.note: At minimum, 6 category band labels (Engineer, Designer, Manager, Analyst, Sales, Support) should be visible.

axes.note: At least one numeric salary axis. path.domain is always created by d3.axis; models that skip .attr('class','axis') on the parent g are matched via path.domain. Max=30 accommodates one path.domain per tick group.

filter_controls.note: Required: category filter controls (buttons or checkboxes). Min=4 tolerates partial implementations.

tooltip.note: Tooltip element must exist in DOM.

encodings.note: Circles positioned by cx (salary axis) are the primary encoding.

hover.note: Hovering a circle populates the tooltip DOM; checked via innerHTML length diff.

filter.note: Clicking a category control changes the number of visible circles; checked via count diff before/after click.

notes: filter_controls.count min=4 allows builds that collapse Engineer+Designer or similar pairs.
The hover trigger uses .last (last matching element) to avoid hitting a background circle with no tooltip handler.
Tooltip selector expanded with #tip as a common alternate id.
axes.selector: path.domain added 2026-05-03 — d3.axis creates path.domain unconditionally; some models omit the parent g class.
